about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The operating brand of PT Kirana Karina Network. We provide dedicated internet, fiber, and managed IT services for business.
about.storyTitle: K2NET — ISP and managed services from Bandung
about.storyText: K2NET is the brand of PT Kirana Karina Network.
about.historyP1: PT Kirana Karina Network built K2NET as an internet service and managed-services operator, with operations in Cikutra, Bandung. Our focus is dedicated connectivity and IT operations support for businesses in West Java.
about.historyP2: Independent routing identity is recorded as ASN AS153992 (AS-Name IDNIC-K2NET-ID) and IPv4 prefix 165.99.252.0/24. Public lookup is available in the IDNIC/APNIC registries.
about.timeline1Text: PT Kirana Karina Network was established in Bandung as an internet service provider.
about.timeline2Text: Obtained ASN AS153992 from IDNIC (AS-Name: IDNIC-K2NET-ID) and IPv4 prefix 165.99.252.0/24.
about.timeline3Text: Operating as ISP and MSP — serving businesses, schools, and institutions in West Java.
about.visionText: To be a clear, reliable connectivity partner for West Java businesses: dedicated internet, network operations, and managed IT under written contracts.
about.mission1: Deliver dedicated internet and network services with SLAs written into the contract.
about.mission2: Operate the network independently and transparently — including ASN, prefix, and peering.
about.mission3: Support client IT operations through the NOC and managed services.
about.networkHeading: Independent routing with our own ASN and prefix
about.networkIntro: Public routing identity for K2NET. Kept off the header so the homepage stays uncluttered.
about.complianceHeading: Formally operating within Indonesia's internet ecosystem
about.complianceIntro: K2NET operates as an ISP and participates in Indonesia’s internet registry and industry associations.
about.licenseText: K2NET operates as an internet access service provider (ISP) under Indonesia’s Kominfo / Ministry of Communication regulatory framework. The license number appears on official company documents.
about.apjiiText: Indonesia Internet Service Provider Association — the national ISP industry body for policy, peering, and operating standards.
about.idnicText: Indonesia Network Information Center, the NIR under APJII. Source of K2NET’s ASN and prefix (corporate member, AS-Name IDNIC-K2NET-ID).
about.apnicText: Asia Pacific Network Information Centre, the regional internet registry. K2NET’s allocation is recorded via APNIC → IDNIC.

servicesTabs.title: Connectivity and IT operations for schools and institutions
servicesTabs.subtitle: Choose a tab: internet from K2NET, or day-to-day IT support on campus.
servicesTabs.isp1Desc: Dedicated connectivity for offices and institutions. Capacity and SLA are agreed in the contract after a site survey.
servicesTabs.isp2Desc: 50–100 Mbps internet for shop-houses, small offices, and school units that need more than a home plan.
servicesTabs.isp3Desc: Home and retail plans within K2NET coverage, starting at 10 Mbps (up to 15 Mbps).
servicesTabs.isp4Desc: Coverage check in Bandung and surrounding areas, then install based on what the site can support.
servicesTabs.isp5Desc: Public IP for Dedicated Internet follows the service plan — not a /29 for every package.
servicesTabs.isp6Desc: Incidents go through the NOC and Service Desk. Response times follow the contract.
servicesTabs.msp1Desc: LAN, WiFi, and basic documentation for a school or office — based on the floor plan and drop count.
servicesTabs.msp2Desc: Scheduled visits, incident repair, and device checks so labs and admin stay online.
servicesTabs.msp3Desc: Install and maintain local servers and school apps (admin, e-learning, exams).
servicesTabs.msp4Desc: Cameras, recording, and scheduled care for campus areas named in the contract.
servicesTabs.msp5Desc: On-site help for computer-based exams, enrollment, or school events that need a stable network.
servicesTabs.msp6Desc: Extra scope under a Custom contract: multi-building, labs, or work outside Basic/Standard.

clients.focus2Body: Managed-service scope can include servers, school applications, and cameras — as contracted.
clients.focus3Body: Operational support during online exams or school events, with escalation through the Service Desk.

sla.title: Service commitments written into the contract
sla.body: Availability targets, support hours, and incident escalation are agreed per service — Dedicated Internet, broadband, or managed services. Any compensation follows the signed contract; we do not publish a universal uptime figure.
sla.panelBody: ASN AS153992 · IDNIC member. Service targets follow the signed document, not marketing numbers.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Activation, public IP, SLA, and K2NET coverage.
faq.q1: How long does Dedicated Internet installation take?
faq.a1: After a site survey. If coverage is already in place, work is faster. New last-mile depends on the site — the schedule is confirmed after the survey.
faq.q2: Does Dedicated Internet include a public IP?
faq.a2: Public IP follows the plan and contract. It is not a /29 for every service.
faq.q3: What if service misses the SLA?
faq.a3: Report incidents to the NOC or Service Desk. Any compensation follows the signed contract.
faq.a4: Bandung and nearby West Java. Last-mile availability is checked with a site survey.
